Community searches found no FHIR-22744 discussion or conflicting work-group record; one Zulip term hit concerned unrelated terminology validation for condition-example-linkage.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch because the accepted FHIR-22744 source change is already present and the original unresolved reference is gone.
